L87: 
L88: Created by legendary independent developer Cyan and based on the genre-defining original released in 1993, Myst has been rebuilt from the ground up with great care by its original creators to take advantage of the latest advances in graphical fidelity.

L91: # About the Original
L92: 
L93: Myst was released in September of 1993, and quickly became the best-selling PC game of all time, a title it held until the end of the millennium.
